Very personal service
Mar 2020
We dined here twice, on the 8th and 14th of March. The first time was International Womens day and the staff wrote a card for my wife. The second time we were the only diners. We had three of their signature dishes being the "I wanna cry shrimp", grilled squid salad and the thoroughly satisfying "one bite pork noodle bundles" on our first trip; and on the second we opted for grilled beef rolls in piper leaves, and the northern light spicy grilled squid, which was spicy. The staff took their time to ask about any allergies and level of spice. hopefully they will reopen soon. There were three restaurants in this building, and this one is on level 5, you enter through the ground floor one and up a lift.

Delightful place to enjoy our last dinner in Vietnam!
Mar 2020
located in a good / vibey area. We were there on March 15 - during the COVID 19 outbreak. We were the last guests on the last day of business before lockdown. This did not detract from our experience at all. We were welcomed by all with friendly smiles and comments. The Staff were just great, helpful with menu suggestions and attentive. The meals chosen suited our different tastes and were really tasty, well presented and great. we enjoyed superb coconut cream coffee - must be tried! We were given a beautiful handmade "thank you" card when we left. All round really worth the visit. They are difficult to find. - at 130 Nguyen Trai (street), only have a SMALL sign outside the restaurant below on street level. Enter the ground floor restaurant and tell them you want to go to the 5th floor. and there you'll find your host waiting for the lift door to open and to welcome you. support them when the lock down is lifted - - they're just great!

Our frist meal in Ho Chi Minh City
Mar 2020 • Family
We cam here abt 1w ago. Their location is on the
 5th floor so we went through another restaurant. Extremely hungry and couldn't wait any longer, we ordered 1 starer to share and 2 mains for each. Trust me the grilled squid salad was wonderful. I could feel the sour, sweet, a little bit spicy in that dish. The squid was so fresh as if they just caught from the sea. Not only was the stater delicious but also 2 mains were fantastic. I gave a try on mekong river fish and my daughter had grilled shrimp with black pepper sauce. The fish was absolutely boneless. I was pretty impressed by the smell of deep-fried lemongrass. The filet fish was crispy outside and juicy inside. To the shrimp, they marinated with the homemade sauce. It might include garlic, black pepper and some flour. The sauce was thick like condensed milk. Enjoying with hot white rice was perfect combination. OMG I coudn't ask for more .The mocktails was amazing, I was addicted. After we finished, the manager gave us some places to go in Sai Gon, help us o treat you, make you feel like being home. Thank you for your warm welcome. I will definitely recommend for my friends if they visit Sai Gon.

The best dinner of my time in Vietnam
Mar 2020
Really - dinner there last night was the culinary highlight of my ten days in Vietnam, a country with one of the most delicate and interesting cuisines in the world. As a starter, I had the most delicious prawns with a fiery dipping sauce, but not so fiery that it blew away the sweetness and freshness of the seafood.
For my main course, I had difficulty choosing, but eventually decided on river fish with a green chilli sauce. It looked quite beautiful, but greed overcame everything and I forgot to take a photograph. The fish was perfectly cooked, and came with a salad of green mango and carrot, rice and spiced corn. So far, so fabulous. But then there was the green chilli sauce, a perfect balance of sweet, sour and heat. Amazing! I'm not sitting on the fence here. I loved this restaurant.

Really super little restaurant.
Feb 2020 • Couples
We booked and turned up around 7.30 to find a tiny, virtually empty restaurant. I’ve no idea why this place wasn’t bombed out because the staff were warm and friendly, extremely helpful when it came to ordering and very attentive throughout. Our table was adequate and comfortable. The simple menu is great, offering very well prepared, delicious local food in large portions for little cost. We shared two starters, I wanna cry shrimp, hot and spicy, and chicken wings, sweet and sticky. We followed by sharing a delicious fried Black Pomfret fish. The cocktails were similarly great and cheap so we had several. Absolutely lovely evening out. Can’t recommend this place more highly - 10 out of 10.
